title: The beautiful tour
text:
It is super interesting, and the guide was very kind and competent.

author: Odette_T

title: Great exploration of Seville
text: Fantastic introduction to Seville. Bryant was super knowledgeable and, as a result of being part of a small group, he was able to tailor the tour to our own interests. Learned lots about the history of Seville, saw many of the main sites, visited the tapas and market place to sample local culture too. A great tour!
author: JoeB4481

title: First time to Sevilla
text:
Natalia our host was very flexible for our request for pick up location and sites to see. We were on a tight schedule for the day. 
In advance we were asked what highlights to visit followed by her recommendations.
author: joe_c

title: Nice and informative tour
text: Very interesting tour with the historical knowledge we wanted! We had a great time and much better understood the city, its history and traditions.
author: 73paulineg

title: The guid was friendly and...
text: The guid was friendly and eager to make our stay better. She told Interesting stories with a sense of humor
author: Natalia_R

title: A great personal tour of Seville
text: We had toured the Cathedral and Alcazar the day before, so Pedro tailored our tour to our interests and avoided that which we had already seen.  Pedro is a native of Seville, but spent many years in the US, so his english is perfect, and knew stories and places that other guides would likely not know.  We felt like we really got to know Seville.  I would highly recommend Pedro
author: Jeffrey_T
